title: Illegal Stamp Issues from Kyrgyzstan | PWO
text: ← UPU Circulars by Country Version française → Illegal Stamp Issues from Kyrgyzstan Kyrgyzstan – Illegal Issues of Postage Stamps UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, 5 May 2003 International Bureau Circular 172 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of KYRGYZSTAN asks me to inform you of the following: "The postal administration of Kyrgyzstan has information about illegal issues of postage stamps bearing the symbol of Kyrgyzstan. "The following issues: – the miniature sheet issued in 2002, comprising nine (3x3) "HARRY POTTER" stamps with a face value of three times 10 KGS, three times 20 KGS and three times 30 KGS; – the two miniature sheets issued in 2002, comprising nine (3x3) "MERRY CHRISTMAS" (cartoon heroes) stamps with a face value of three times 10 KGS, three times 20 KGS and three times 30 KGS; – the miniature sheet issued in 2002, comprising nine (3x3) "SHAHMATY" stamps with a face value of 20 KGS; – the block of stamps issued in 2001, comprising three "JOHN PAUL II" stamps with a face value of 10 KGS, 20 KGS and 30 KGS, were published in contravention of the Universal Postal Convention and Kyrgyz legislation. Consequently, since these stamps were not issued by the postal administration of Kyrgyzstan, they may not be used as a means of postal prepayment ". Yours faithfully, K J S McKEOWN Director of Communication and Postal Markets UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, 3 June 2002 International Bureau Circular 208 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of KYRGYZSTAN asks me to inform you of the following: "The postal administration of Kyrgyzstan has information about illegal issues of stamps bearing the symbol of the Republic of Kyrgyzstan. It asks that the following information be sent to Union member countries: – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Shrek". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Defenders of Peace and Freedom". Face value: 10 C, 10 C, 10 C, 20 C, 20 C, 20 C, 30 C, 30 C, 30 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Tiger". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Harry Potter". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – block of one stamp "Harry Potter". Face value of stamp: 100 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Ironman". Face value:10 C, 10 C, 10 C, 20 C, 20 C, 20 C, 30 C, 30 C, 30 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Formula 1". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Superman". Face value: 10 C, 10 C, 10 C, 20 C, 20 C, 20 C, 30 C, 30 C, 30 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Mother Teresa". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Flash". Face value: 10 C, 10 C, 10 C, 20 C, 20 C, 20 C, 30 C, 30 C, 30 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "The Beatles". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Legends of Baseball". Face value: 10 C, 10 C, 10 C, 20 C, 20 C, 20 C, 30 C, 30 C, 30 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Dogs". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Green Lantern". Face value: 10 C, 10 C, 10 C, 20 C, 20 C, 20 C, 30 C, 30 C, 30 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 9 (3 x 3) "Concorde". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – number of stamps in sheet: 6 (3 x 2) "Harley Davidson". Face value of each stamp: 20 C; – block of 3 stamps "Princess Diana". Face value: 10 C, 20 C, 30 C; – block of 3 stamps "Elvis". Face value: 10 C, 20 C, 30 C; – block of one stamp "Penguins". Face value of stamp: 100 C. "These stamps have been issued in violation of the Regulations of the Universal Postal Convention and Kyrgyz legislation and, not having been issued by the competent authorities, cannot be accepted as means of postal prepayment. Yours faithfully, K J S McKEOWN Director of Communication and Postal Markets Kyrgyzstan – Illegal Issues of Postage Stamps UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, 30 July 2001 International Bureau Circular 308 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of KYRGYZSTAN asks me to inform you of the following: "The postal administration of Kyrgyzstan has learned that illegal issues of postage stamps with the symbol of its State are still being advertised on a website. We should therefore be grateful if you would inform Union member countries of the following. "The following stamp series: ● series of 9 stamps "Backstreet Boys", face value 20 s; ● series of 6 stamps "Jennifer Aniston", face value 20 s; ● series of 6 stamps "Tennis", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "Beverly Hills 90210", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "Minerals", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "Penguins", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "Tom and Jerry", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "Prince William", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "Babylon 5", face value 20 s; ● series of 9 stamps "End of Mir", face value 20 s were issued in violation of the Detailed Regulations of the UPU Convention and the legislation of the Republic of Kyrgyzstan. They can not therefore be accepted as a means of postal prepayment." Yours faithfully, M MAZOU Deputy Director General UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, 10 July 2000 International Bureau Circular 258 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of KYRGYZSTAN asks me to inform you that it has received information about illegal issues of postage stamps in its name. These stamps have the symbol of the State printed on them, just like official issues. They show motifs representing Western show business personalities and have been reproduced in a Japanese periodical. All "Beatles" and "Madonna" stamps with a face value of 20 s have therefore been issued in contravention of the provisions of the Detailed Regulations of the Universal Postal Convention and the laws of the Republic of Kyrgyzstan. As the postal administration of Kyrgyzstan has never issued such postage stamps, they cannot be accepted as a means of postage. Yours faithfully, M S RAMAN UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, 13 December 1999 International Bureau Circular 432 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of KYRGYZSTAN asks me to inform you about the illegal issue of postage stamps relating to its State. The following stamps have been issued in contravention of the Detailed Regulations of the Universal Postal Convention and the legislation of the Kyrgyz Republic: "Chess" set, 10, 15, 20 soms; "71st Academicians' annual award ceremony" set, 20 soms; "Playthings" set, 15 soms; "Cats" set, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1000, 1600, 2000, 24 100 tiyns; "Princess Diana" stamps and blocks, 1000, 5000 tiyns; "Bruce Willis" stamps, 10 soms. In view of the above, these stamps are to be regarded as illegal and may not be used for the prepayment of postage. Yours faithfully, M S RAMAN Assistant Director-General More information about the illegal issues can be obtained directly from the UPU, Mrs. Maria Libera . Published: 08/18/2001. Revised: 05/09/03 . title: Emissions de timbres illégales - Mauritanie | PWO
text: ← Circulaires UPU par pays English original → Emissions de timbres illégales - Mauritanie MAURITANIE – Emissions illégales de timbres-poste UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE Berne, le 28 avril 2003 Circulaire du Bureau international 161 Madame, Monsieur, L’administration postale de la MAURITANIE me prie de vous faire part de ce qui suit: «Nous vous prions de communiquer à tous les Pays membres de l’Union et à tous nos partenaires philatéliques de l’Association mondiale pour le développement de la philatélie nos vives préoccupations quant à la prolifération continue d’émissions illégales de timbres-poste, phénomène dont est victime notre administration pos­tale. Nous venons d’apprendre que toute une série d’émissions de timbres-poste frau­duleux portant l’inscription ‹RÉPUBLIQUE ISLAMIQUE DE MAURITANIE› sont apparues sur différents sites Internet et dans des publications promotionnelles philatéliques. Nous avons recensé pas moins de 95 timbres-poste illégaux. Par conséquent, nous émettons les plus vives protestations contre ces timbres-poste illégaux. La publicité trompeuse va jusqu’à prétendre que ‹l’origine de ces timbres peut être remise en question, et ils peuvent être listés comme des timbres-poste illégaux. Nous suggérons, par conséquent, de les acheter uniquement parce qu’ils vous plaisent; nous vous les offrons parce qu’ils sont sur le marché.› Non seulement la valeur faciale est indiquée en UM et le prix de vente des timbres est assez élevé, mais la plupart de ces timbres sont vendus dans des formats perforés et imperforés. Le comble de la fraude faisant que la version non perforée est ven­due au double du prix des perforés. La publicité trompeuse faite à l’égard de notre pays à travers ces timbres-poste illé­gaux représente une grave atteinte à l'intégrité morale, religieuse et économique de la Mauritanie, à son service postal et à l’Union postale universelle dans son ensemble. Il s’agit d’une violation grave et flagrante de l’article 6 de la Convention postale universelle et de ses dispositions connexes du Règlement de la poste aux lettres. Il s’agit notamment d’une violation de la législation nationale de la Répu­blique islamique de Mauritanie, notamment de la loi sur la poste et ses dispositions en matière de contrefaçon de timbres-poste. Aux termes de cette loi, la Société mauritanienne des postes est la seule habilitée à émettre et à diffuser des timbres-poste au nom de la République islamique de Mau­ritanie. La situation est d’autant plus grave avec les émissions illégales que les logos de différentes organisations sont reproduits sur la plupart des timbres-poste. Ces orga­nisations peuvent penser que nous avons utilisé leurs logos à leur insu, et nous sommes en droit de redouter des poursuites de la part de ces organisations pour avoir abusé de leur propriété intellectuelle. Nous en appelons à tous pour redoubler d’efforts pour lutter contre ce fléau de timbres-poste illégaux et exercer une vigilance accrue à l’égard de la production et la distribution de tels timbres dans leurs pays respectifs. Nous comptons sur la colla­boration de tous pour identifier et poursuivre les malfaiteurs responsables de ces délits. Nous saisissons cette occasion pour préciser que notre administration postale n’a pas émis de timbres-poste depuis la fin de 2000. Les timbres-poste qui ont cours légal peuvent être achetés directement à l’adresse suivante: MAURIPOST Service philatélique Direction générale B.P. 10000 NOUAKCHOTT MAURITANIE Fax: +222 525 5 (1) 74 La liste des timbres-poste que nous avons trouvés jusqu’ici et que nous dénonçons se trouve en annexe.» Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l’assurance de ma haute considération. Le Directeur des marchés, K.J.S. McKEOWN Annexe Emissions illégales de timbres-poste produites au nom de la République islamique de Mauritanie Onze feuillets (1) composés de six timbres-poste représentant chacun une espèce différente d’oiseaux (dont des oiseaux de proie, canards, faisans, oiseaux des champs et oiseaux maritimes). La valeur indiquée sur chaque timbre-poste est de 80 UM, et chaque timbre-poste reproduit le millésime 2002 ainsi que le logo de l’organisation des scouts. title: Illegal Stamp Issues from Mauritania | PWO
text: ← UPU Circulars by Country Version française → Illegal Stamp Issues from Mauritania Mauritania - Illegal Postage Stamps UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne 28 April 2003 International Bureau Circular 161 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of the ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF MAURITANIA asks me to inform you of the following: "Kindly inform all Union member countries and all our philatelic partners within the World Association for the Development of Philately that we are greatly concerned by the continuing proliferation of illegal postage stamps, a phenomenon of which our postal administration is a victim. "We have just learnt of the appearance of a whole series of fraudulent postage stamps inscribed "REPUBLIQUE ISLAMIQUE DE MAURITANIE" on various websites and in philatelic promotional publications. We have recorded no fewer than 95 illegal stamps. "We therefore wish to protest in the strongest terms against these illegal postage stamps. The deceitful advertising goes so far as to state that "the origin of these stamps may be questionable and may be listed as illegals. We therefore suggest that you buy them only because you like them. We offer them because they are on the market". As well as having face values in UM and a rather high selling price, most of these stamps are sold in perforated and imperforate formats. Worse still, the imperforate versions sell for double the price of perforate ones. "The negative publicity these illegal postage stamps generate for our country amounts to a serious attack on the moral, religious and economic integrity of Mauritania, its postal service and the Universal Postal Union as a whole. It is a serious and flagrant violation of article 6 of the Universal Postal Convention and the associated provisions of the Letter Post Regulations. It is, in particular, a violation of the national legislation of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, and in particular its law on the Post and its provisions on counterfeit postage stamps. "Under the terms of this law, the Mauritanian Postal Corporation alone is authorized to issue and disseminate postage stamps in the name of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania. "This situation is further aggravated by the fact that the logos of various organizations are reproduced on most of the illegal postage stamps. These organizations may be led to believe that we have used their logos without permission and these organizations could take legal action against us for breach of copyright. "We call upon all parties to redouble their efforts to combat the scourge of illegal postage stamps and to exercise increased vigilance with regard to the production and distribution of such stamps in their respective countries. We are counting on the cooperation of all to help identify and track down the criminals responsible. "We would take this opportunity to state that our postal administration has not issued any postage stamps since the end of 2000. Legally valid postage stamps may be purchased directly from the following address: MAURIPOST Service philatélique Direction générale B.P. 10000 NOUAKCHOTT MAURITANIA Fax: (+222) 525 51 74 "A list of the illegal postage stamps identified to date is annexed." title: Emissions de timbres illégales - Rwanda | PWO
text: ← Circulaires UPU par pays English original → Emissions de timbres illégales - Rwanda UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE Berne, le 3 2001 Circulaire du Bureau international 363 RWANDA – Emissions illégales de timbres-poste Madame, Monsieur, L’administration postale du RWANDA me prie de vous communiquer ce qui suit: «Nous vous prions de rendre attentifs tous les Pays-membres de notre Union et tous nos partenaires philatéliques membres de l'Association mondiale pour le développement de la philatélie à la nécessité et à l'urgence de prendre toutes les mesures possibles pour que cesse la campagne de dénigrement et d'avilissement dont fait l'objet non seulement notre pays, mais, comme nous l'avons constaté, beaucoup d'autres pays, à travers la production et la dissémination de timbres-poste illégaux. Ces derniers sont offensants pour notre pays, pour la philatélie et pour l'Union tout entière. Notre administration a été informée de l’existence sur le marché philatélique de nombreuses séries de feuillets de timbres-poste aux divers motifs et qui portent l’inscription ‹RWANDA›. Nous tenons à préciser que ces timbres-poste sont illégaux et qu’ils ont été émis à notre insu. Leur circulation a déjà causé un préjudice moral et économique sérieux aux services postaux rwandais, et continue à le faire. Suite à une première enquête déjà effectuée, nous avons des preuves qu'une certaine société enregistrée en Belgique avait distribué lesdits timbres-poste. Des actions en justice ont déjà été engagées pour rechercher et traduire les faussaires devant les tribunaux. Nous poursuivons notre enquête pour trouver les imprimeurs. Le plus choquant, pour notre pays et notre administration, réside dans le fait que certains feuillets illustrent des scènes pornographiques. Ceci est d’autant plus répréhensible qu’il est interdit d’utiliser la poste pour le transport de matériel pornographique. Lesdits timbres-poste illégaux ont été émis en violation des dispositions de la Convention postale universelle (notamment les art. 6 et 25), de son Règlement de la poste aux lettres et de la législation nationale de la République rwandaise. Lesdits timbres-poste n’ont non seulement pas de valeur d’affranchissement, mais ils n’ont en outre aucune valeur pour les collectionneurs aux fins de collection au nom de notre pays. L'existence de tels timbres-poste a discrédité notre service postal aux yeux des philatélistes du monde entier. En conséquence, nous demandons à toutes les administrations postales de ne pas accepter les correspondances affranchies au moyen de ces timbres-poste illégaux, si jamais ils se présentent sur des correspondances arrivant du Rwanda. Nous demandons que lesdites correspondances nous soient retournées. Par ailleurs, nous saurions gré à toutes les administrations postales d’accroître leur propre vigilance et de nous informer, ainsi que le Bureau international, si elles disposent de renseignements concernant la distribution de tels timbres-poste dans leur pays. Nous prions les administrations d’en informer également tous leurs partenaires philatéliques.» Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'assurance de ma haute considération. Le Directeur de la communication et des marchés postaux, K.J.S. McKEOWN Annexe Timbres-poste illégaux émis en feuillets au nom de la République du Rwanda A noter: les valeurs indiquées sur les timbres-poste constituant les feuillets décrits ci-après représentent des valeurs élevées par rapport aux tarifs de base en vigueur au Rwanda pour l’affranchissement. Les tarifs élevés indiqués sont destinés à tromper l’acheteur. En outre, la monnaie au Rwanda est le FRW, et non le F, comme indiqué. 1 et 2. Deux feuillets composés de 9 timbres-poste illustrant diverses scènes pornographiques et érotiques. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 3. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste illustrant divers modèles d’autobus à deux étages. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 4. Un feuillet composé de 6 timbres-poste illustrant diverses sortes de roses. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 5. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste illustrant divers modèles de montgolfières (entre autres un dragon, un dinosaure, un éléphant, une maison, des visages). Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 6. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste illustrant diverses voitures (des modèles anciens). Sur le fond de chaque timbre-poste, on voit de l’animation et la présence de nombreuses personnes. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 7. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste illustrant une prise différente d’un motocycle en mouvement lors d’une course. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 8. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste illustrant des trains (divers modèles et prises de vue). Les valeurs portent l’année 1999 en haut à gauche. Les valeurs se trouvent en haut à droite et se suivent horizontalement: 100 F, 150 F, 200 F, 250 F, 300 F, 350 F, 400 F, 450 F et 500 F. 9. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et «Leaders of XI–XIXth Century» (en bas du feuillet). Chaque timbre-poste illustre un monarque ou un chef d’Etat des XIe au XIXe siècles (chaque timbre-poste identifie, sur le côté gauche, de manière verticale et dans la langue anglaise, le nom et le siècle de la personnalité en question). Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 10. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et «Architecture of XI–XIXth Century» (en bas du feuillet), illustrant des monuments et bâtiments datant des XIe au XIXe siècles (chaque timbre-poste identifie, sur le côté gauche, de manière verticale et dans la langue anglaise, le nom du monument ou du bâtiment et le siècle en question). Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 11. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et «Art of XI–XIXth Century» (en bas du feuillet), illustrant des œuvres d’art diverses datant des XIe au XIXe siècles (chaque timbre-poste identifie, sur le côté gauche, de manière verticale et dans la langue anglaise, le nom de l’œuvre d’art et le siècle en question). Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 12. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et «Events and famous people of XI–XIXth Century» (en bas du feuillet), illustrant diverses personnalités des XIe au XIXe siècles (chaque timbre-poste identifie, sur le côté gauche, de manière verticale et dans la langue anglaise, le nom de l’événement ou de la personnalité ainsi que le siècle en question). Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 13. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et portant l’inscription «Music stars of XXth Century» (en bas du feuillet), illustrant diverses personnalités de la chanson du XXe siècle. Le chanteur ou le groupe de chanteurs est identifié dans la langue anglaise, soit par une inscription en haut à gauche, de manière verticale ou horizontale, soit par la reproduction d’une affiche ou d’une couverture de disque. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 14. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et portant l’inscription «Movie stars of XXth Century» (en bas du feuillet au milieu); en bas à gauche, l’année 1999 et, à droite, l’inscription «Senior». Diverses personnalités du cinéma américain et français sont représentées (décédées et vivantes) à partir de photographies. Le nom de chaque personnalité est identifié, dans la langue anglaise, par une inscription en haut à gauche, de manière verticale. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 15. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et portant l’inscription «Movie stars of XXth Century» (en bas du feuillet au milieu); en bas à gauche, l’année 1999 et, à droite, l’inscription «Medium». Diverses personnalités du cinéma américain sont représentées à partir de photographies. Le nom de chaque personnalité est identifié, dans la langue anglaise, par une inscription en haut à gauche, de manière verticale. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 16. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et portant l’inscription «Movie stars of XXth Century» (en bas du feuillet au milieu); en bas à gauche, l’année 1999 et, à droite, l’inscription «Junior». Diverses personnalités du cinéma américain sont représentées à partir de photographies. Le nom de chaque personnalité est identifié, dans la langue anglaise, par une inscription en haut à gauche, de manière verticale. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 17. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et portant l’inscription «Music stars of XXth Century» (en bas du feuillet au milieu); en bas à gauche, l’année 1999 et, à droite, l’inscription «Medium». Diverses personnalités américaines de la chanson sont représentées à partir de photographies. Le nom de chaque personnalité est identifié, dans la langue anglaise, par une inscription en haut à gauche, de manière verticale. Les valeurs sont disposées verticalement par colonne de 100 F, 200 F et 300 F. 18. Un feuillet composé de 9 timbres-poste commémorant le «Millenium» (en haut du feuillet) et portant l’inscription «Music stars of XXth Century» (en bas du feuillet au milieu); en bas à gauche, l’année 1999 et, à droite, l’inscription «Junior». Il s’agit de divers moyens de transport à partir de photographies. A signaler qu’un certain motif est reproduit sur la bordure en haut et en bas de chaque colonne verticale de timbres-poste. 20bis. title: Illegal Stamp Issues in the Name of Rwanda | PWO
text: ← UPU Circulars by Country Version française → Illegal Stamp Issues in the Name of Rwanda RWANDA – Illegal Issues of Postage Stamps UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, September 2001 International Bureau Circular 363 Dear Sir/Madam The postal administration of RWANDA asks me to inform you of the following: "We would ask you to draw to the attention of all member countries of our Union, and all our philatelic partners within the World Association for the Development of Philately, the urgent need to take all possible steps to bring an end to the campaign of denigration and debasement to which not only our country but, as we have observed, numerous other countries are being subjected, in the form of the production and dissemination of illegal postage stamps. Such stamps are an offence to our country, to philately and to the Union as a whole. "Our administration has learned of the existence on the philatelic market of numerous series of miniature sheets of postage stamps with various designs, bearing the inscription "RWANDA". We wish to state that these postage stamps are illegal and have been issued without our knowledge. Their circulation has already done serious moral and economic harm to the Rwandan postal services, and continues to do so. "Following initial inquiries, we now have proof that a certain company registered in Belgium distributed the stamps in question. Legal action has already been initiated to trace the forgers and bring them to justice. Our efforts to trace the printers are continuing. "The most outrageous aspect for our country and our administration is the fact that certain miniature sheets illustrate pornographic scenes. This is all the more reprehensible in as much as it is prohibited to use the Post to convey pornographic materials. All these illegal stamps have been issued in contravention of the Universal Postal Convention (especially articles 6 and 25), its Letter Post Regulations and the legislation of the Republic of Rwanda. "The stamps have no postal prepayment value, and nor do they have any value for philatelists collecting our country's stamps. The existence of such postage stamps has discredited our postal service in the eyes of philatelists the world over. "Consequently, we would ask all postal administrations not to accept mail items bearing these illegal stamps, should they appear on correspondence reaching them from Rwanda. Such items should be returned to us. "We would also ask for extra vigilance on the part of all postal administrations, which are requested to pass on to us, and to the International Bureau, any information they may have regarding the distribution of such postage stamps within their country. Administrations are also asked to inform all their philatelic partners. Yours faithfully, K.J.S. McKEOWN Director of Communication and Postal Markets Annex Illegal postage stamps issued in miniature sheets, purportedly by the Republic of Rwanda NB.– The values shown on the postage stamps that make up the miniature sheets described below are high in comparison with the basic postage rates in use in Rwanda. The high rates indicated are designed to deceive purchasers. Furthermore, the currency of Rwanda is the FRW, not the F as indicated. 1 & 2 Two miniature sheets comprising nine postage stamps illustrating various pornographic and erotic scenes. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 3 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps illustrating various models of double-decker buses. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 4 One miniature sheet comprising six postage stamps illustrating various varieties of roses. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 5 A miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps illustrating various models of hot air balloons (including a dragon, a dinosaur, an elephant, a house and faces). The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 6 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps illustrating various cars (old models). At the bottom of each postage stamp, there are lively crowd scenes. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 7 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps illustrating different views of a motorcycle in action during a race. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 8 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps illustrating trains (various models and views). These stamps are dated 1999 in the top left-hand corner. The values are in the top right-hand corner, in a horizontal sequence: 100F, 150F, 200F, 250F, 300F, 350F, 400F, 450F and 500F. 9 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and "Leaders of XI – XIXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet). Each postage stamp illustrates a monarch or head of state from the 11th to 19th centuries. Each postage stamp identifies, on the left-hand side, in English text running vertically, the name of the historical figure and the century in question. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 10 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and "Architecture of XI – XIXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet), illustrating monuments and buildings from the 11th to 19th centuries. (Each postage stamp identifies, on the left-hand side, in English text running vertically, the name of the monument or building and the century in question). The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 11 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and "Art of XI – XIXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet), illustrating various works of art from the 11th to 19th centuries. (Each postage stamp identifies, on the left-hand side, in English text running vertically, the name of the work of art and the century in question). The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 12 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and "famous people of XI – XIXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet), illustrating various figures from the 11th to 19th centuries. (Each postage stamp identifies, on the left-hand side, in English text running vertically, the name of the event or historical figure and the century in question). The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 13 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and with the inscription "Music stars of XXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet), illustrating various famous singers of the 20th century. The singer or group is identified in English, either with an inscription in English in the top left-hand corner, running vertically or horizontally, or with the reproduction of a poster or a record sleeve. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 14 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and with the inscription "Movie stars of XXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet); dated 1999 in the bottom left-hand corner, with the inscription "Senior" on the right. Various figures from American and French films (dead and alive) are illustrated with photographs. Each star is identified in English with an inscription in the top left-hand corner, running vertically. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 15 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and with the inscription "Movie stars of XXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet); dated 1999 in the bottom left-hand corner, with the inscription "Medium" on the right. Various figures from American films are illustrated with photographs. Each star is identified in English with an inscription in the top left-hand corner, running vertically. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 16 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and with the inscription "Movie stars of XXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet); dated 1999 in the bottom left-hand corner, with the inscription "Junior" on the right. Various figures from American films are illustrated with photographs. Each star is identified in English with an inscription in the top left-hand corner, running vertically. The values are in vertical columns of 100F, 200F and 300F. 17 One miniature sheet comprising nine postage stamps commemorating the "Millennium" (at the top of the miniature sheet) and with the inscription "Music stars of XXth Century" (at the bottom of the sheet); dated 1999 in the bottom left-hand corner, with the inscription "Medium" on the right. Various American singers are illustrated with photographs. Each star is identified in English with an inscription in the top left-hand corner, running vertically. title: Illegal Stamp Issues | PWO
text: Illegal Stamp Issues Illegal Stamp Issues On 16th January 2001 the members of the Working Group for Illegal Issues met at the UPU Headquarters in Bern, Switzerland. Since 1996 approx. 46 postal administrations announced problems with illegal/illicit stamps to the UPU. At the meeting of the Management Committee of the World Association for the Development of Philately in Tunis President Mohr proposed to introduce a special numbering for all stamp issued and to list them on the UPU Web site. The Philatelic Webmasters Organization actively collaborates with the Universal Postal Union in order to stop the issuing of illegal stamps. We publish here a list of countries that sent denunciations to the UPU. The list in not complete, but gives a good idea of countries which issues are under attack. Beware! Afghanistan No stamps were issued since 1989. All starting with 1990 are illicit. Angola Three companies located in Belgium, Great Britain and Lithuania issued stamps in its name. The accompanying list includes 60 sheetlets of 6 stamps, 2 sheetlets of 9 stamps, and 1 sheetlet each of 2 and 4 stamps on popular topics such as Flora, Fauna, Trains, and Millennium. Argentina Azerbaijan Bosnia & Herzegovina Central African Republic Chad Five stamp sets with values: 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 F on Elephants, Cats, and 130th birth anniversary of Gandhi, a six stamp set on Butterflies, with values: 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350 F Congo Cyprus "Turkish Cypriot Postal Administration": the 125th anniversary of the UPU and the eclipse of the sun on 11 August 1999. Equatorial Guinea Georgia Non less then 202 series of illegal stamps. The list will be distributed officially shortly by the UPU. Greece Kyrgyzstan This country is denouncing a Web site based in the US (www.marlen-stamps.com) that carries illegal stamps in its name and in the name of many other places as well. These stamps have the symbol of the State printed on them, just like official issues. They display Western personalities of the show business. All “Beatles” and “Madonna” stamps with a face value of 20s weren't issued by the postal administration of Kyrgyzstan either. Laos Mali Between 14 March and 18 April 2000, were issued nine different series of postage stamps bearing the inscription "Republique Du Mali", with various designs. Issued in set of 9 values: 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500 F, on: Trains, Chess, Prehistoric animals, Magellan, Mushrooms, Computers, Dogs, Columbus, Minerals. These "pirate issues" were produced in Eastern Europe on behalf of a company located in Great Britain. Mexico Morocco All postage stamps bearing the inscription République Arabe Sahraoui Démocratique showing various designs. title: Sites showing/selling illegal stamps
text: Sites Showing /Selling Illegal Stamps A certain number of illegal stamps which are the subject of IB Circulars, distributed by the UPU at the request of its member countries, could and can still be found on the Internet sites listed below . We strongly advise all collectors to be wary of such "so-called stamps" and to double-check the authenticity of whatever they see on these sites. Delcampe.com , Belgium Marlen Stamp & Coin Ltd ., NY, USA Europhila Stamp Ltd. , P.O. Box 1099, 3042 Kaunas, Lithuania, tel (+370-7)-2598-04. Source UPU . BiStamp , a Belarus stamp company Dealers Selling Illegal Stamps on eBay Unfortunately, some dealers and collectors put up illegal stamps for auction on eBay and Delcampe to be sold to unsuspecting people. We remind that the eBay rules assert that sellers assume all responsibility for listing their items. For this reason we warmly recommend to all dealers to check out on this site for the legality of their philatelic items before offering them for sale. We also suggest to all potential buyers to use the information provided on this site before bidding for contemporary stamps. The following sellers either were contacted by the Philatelic Web Watch or its readers, and they declined to answer or to withdraw their offers or they have systematically offered illegal samps: g ambori , Location : California. Country: USA. Proposed illegals from: Russian Federation excollectibles . Location: Manchester NH. Country: USA. Proposed illegals from: Angola. Also newer from Comoros. lbphilatel. Wilmington , USA. Proposed illegals from: Angola . pantonisse. Uden, Netherlands. Proposed illegals from: Rwanda. henny48 . Hong Kong. Illegals from Comoros. ltsung, Ontario, Canada. Illegals from Niger, etc. The readers are invited to send directly to the dealers that are selling illegal stamps an e-mail with the following contents: Your following ... lot(s) offer stamps ostensibly issued by XXXX (country name) but which, according to the International Bureau Circular number YYY of Month, Year, were produced without the authority of the Postal administration of XXXX. According to the UPU these are illegal stamps. We recommend you, in the interest of philately, to abstain in the future from this kind of activity, and we will inform the Philatelic Web Watch about eventual future relapses. Please send each time a CC e-mail to us (remove "spaam"), and let us know in about a week if the dealer hasn't complied with the recommendations of the UPU. NOTES The sites listed here will be deleted from the list only when the owners/publishers will give concrete proofs that they have changed their policies in the domain of illegal stamps. The PWO is determined to fight this plague that gnaws at philately. The PWO is representing here the wishes and hopes of hundreds of thousands of stamp collectors worldwide , and f or this reason, any attempt to divert the PWO of this way is useless and will be reported on the PWO site. Please consider that we can only process denunciations that refer to illegal stamps, i.e. only to those listed as such by the UPU. Some philatelists have decided to put images of illegals on their sites, in order to fight against them. The PWO, following the position of the UPU, finds that this isn't a good idea (please see here for reasons) and consequently won't show images of illegals on its subsite. Some reactions from sellers to whom we explained in personal e-mail s why should they abstain in the future from such a doubtful commercial activity and from readers: "These "stamps" are being sold as collectibles not as postage stamps and I will report you to eBay for monitoring my auctions. Thank you. Mike H." Please click here for an explanation why such stamps aren't collectibles, but just illegals. Phil. Web Watch. "Hi, I ended the auction and will refrain myself from posting it again in the future. You can remove my name from your site now, please. Thanks, X.Y." Thanks, X.Y., for your wise decision . PWW . Hello, Answering your message, I inform you that I had removed from my auctions all my series of stamps of Angola. As I keep the history of all my bids, I contacted the 6 buyers who had already bought from me such stamps. I proposed them a refund of their money on the other purchases. Thanks for having warned me that these stamps were illegal. Very cordially, Jean-Marie. I want to commend you for contacting "excollectibles" who sells illegal stamps on Ebay. I like the way he threatened you for monitoring his auctions! Please let me know what I can do to assist you. Erica. From the Iinternational Bureau of the Universal Postal Union (Sept. 18, 2002) I would like to this opportunity to express again our gratitude to the PWO for the assistance you are providing the UPU in watching out for the sellers of illegal stamps. Maria S. Libera Programme Manager, Markets Development Directorate of Communications and Markets International Bureau of the Universal Postal Union Published: 08/24/2001. title: Illegal Stamp Issues
text: UPU Circulars issued concerning illegal/illicit/problem stamp issues (2002 – 1996) Dear Partners in Philately, 1. Please find attached the circular that has just been issued at the request of Uzbekistan denouncing illegal stamps that have been printed and distributed in its name (the circular is in both the English and French versions). 2. Please continue to note that, based on the information that is available to us, we are helping on an ongoing basis with investigations to process denouncements from the following postal administrations: Afghanistan, Angola, Azerbaidjan, Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, the Union of Comoros, Congo (Republic), Congo (Democratic Republic), Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, East Timor, Estonia, Georgia, Guinea, Guiné-Bissau, Kosovo (UNMIK), Kyrgyzstan, Madagascar, Mali, Morocco (for the Sahara Republic), Union of Myanmar, Niger, the Russian Federation, Rwanda, Sao Tome é Principe, Somalia, Tchad and Turkmenistan. 3. To be noted, additionally, that circulars already issued in the names of a large number of countries have unfortunately not yet stopped the continued proliferation of illegal stamps in the names of these countries. The combat against this serious problem must continue and everyone needs to contribute by sending us as much as material as possible that they see on the market. 4. As part of strengthening the combat against the continuing proliferation of illegal stamps, we would greatly appreciate it if you can inform your collectors and members to continue to be particularly careful when they see issues on the market in the names of the targetted countries, in particular during philatelic exhibitions and in various advertising materials. It is important that they have the listing of the legal issues and they double-check beforehand the authenticity of the stamps they want to purchase, than to regret their purchase later. 5. To be noted also that more and more of the countries concerned have their legal and official stamps on their own websites. More and more countries are also signing up to the UPU's WADP Numbering system which lists the official stamps issued since 1 January 2002 (on www.wnsstamps.ch ). Your comments on the value of this site are welcome. 6. The complete and up-to-date summary of circulars issued to date which denounce illegal stamps is also attached. We are also currently working on expanding the Philatelic entry to the new UPU Website and such information will be available there soon as well. 7. Please also continue to remind your readers and members, on a permanent basis, that they should feel free to contact me directly with any queries that they may have regarding stamps on the market and their authenticity, or any other philatelic issue. Maybe you can include a regular insert on this point in your publication or website with a direct link to my e-mail address as listed below. 8. Please also let me know if there are other organisations, associations or websites which you feel should be receiving this information and be on this distribution list. With best regards, and thank you all for your valuable cooperation. Maria Libera Maria S. title: Des nouveaux virus et de la protection
text: À propos des nouveaux virus et comment s'en protéger Si vous avez reçu dans votre boîte électronique un ver dénommé "W32/Sircam" et que vous suspectez votre ordinateur d'avoir été infecté par ce ver (ou par tout autre virus) vous pouvez faire analyser et nettoyer votre ordinateur gratuitement en ligne sur le site www.antivirus.com . Suivez simplement les instructions qui apparaissent sur votre l'écran. L'analyse prend environ 30 à 45 minutes (en ligne), selon la quantité stockée sur votre disque dur. Le nettoyage est à faire manuellement (hors ligne) en suivant les instructions simples affichées à l'écran, et ne prend que quelques minutes. L'analyse peut être faite de façon anonyme, c'est-à-dire qu'il n'est pas nécessaire d'indiquer votre adresse électronique. Votre ordinateur sera analysé en fonction de tous les virus connus, y compris les tous derniers qui ne figurent pas encore dans de nombreux programmes anti-virus. Si un virus est détecté sur votre ordinateur au cours de l'analyse, les fichiers infectés seront marqués pour vous permettre de les identifier plus facilement et de les nettoyer. Une fois le nettoyage effectué, protégez votre ordinateur contre toute attaque. N'ouvrez JAMAIS un courrier avec des fichiers exécutables attachés, à moins d'être certain à 100% du contenu de ces fichiers attachés, et/ou d'être sûr à 100% du niveau de sécurité de l'ordinateur expéditeur. Si vous avez le moindre doute, passez le fichier joint à l'anti-virus, ou tout simplement supprimez-le de votre ordinateur SANS ouvrir le courrier. Vous trouverez ci-dessous une description de ce ver particulier. C'est un ver joint à un e-mail provenant de Mexico avec des objets divers mais le texte du courrier est (en anglais) du genre : "Hi ! How are you ? I send you this file in order to have your advice. See you later. Thanks." Il existe aussi une version espagnole, du genre : "¿ Hola, como estas ? Te mando este archivo para que me das tu punto de vista. Nos vemos pronto. Gracias." Informations générales W32/Sircam est un ver qui se propage par e-mail, en s'envoyant de lui-même à toutes les adresses trouvées dans le répertoire d'adresses Outlook de l'utilisateur infecté. Une fois installé dans le système, le ver modifie la base de registre de Windows afin de s'exécuter à chaque fois qu'un fichier .exe est lancé. Enfin, une fois sur dix, le ver supprime certaines données du disque dur de l'ordinateur. Mode de propagation Après avoir infecté l'ordinateur, W32/Sircam s'expédie de lui-même à toutes les adresses trouvées dans le répertoire de l'utilisateur infecté [Remarque : le site de Norton indique qu'il peut aussi analyser les fichiers du cache de votre navigateur pour y trouver les adresses e-mail, et s'expédier également à elles. Pour de plus amples renseignements voir : Sarc.com]. Le message envoyé a les caractéristiques suivantes : le fichier joint a une double extension, car le ver infecte le système en s'auto-copiant au début des fichiers cible, et ajoute une autre extension à celle d'origine. Symptômes de l'infection Le premier symptôme de l'infection est la réception d'un message électronique ayant les caractéristiques décrites plus haut. Quand l'utilisateur exécute un fichier infecté, W32/Sircam crée deux copies cachées de lui-même dans le dossier C:\Recycled ("poubelle"). Le nom de la première figure après le fichier joint au message e-mail (sans l'extension ajoutée par le virus), alors que la seconde s'appelle SIRC32.exe. Ensuite, W32/Sircam va créer une troisième copie de lui-même dans le dossier Système de Windows sous le nom de SCAM32.exe. De plus, le ver génère (éventuellement) un fichier dénommé SYRCAM.sys et y écrit du texte jusqu'à ce que tout l'espace disque disponible sont rempli. De NetSecurity.net : Pour les utilisateurs de serveurs NT et 2000, veuillez noter qu'il existe un autre ver nommé "Code Red" qui affecté les serveurs IIS. Un ver est semblable à un virus dans la mesure où il peut se reproduire lui-même. Cependant, contrairement à un virus, il n'infecte pas d'autres fichiers. Ce ver a été réalisé par des chinois dans la cadre d'une attaque du site Internet de la Maison Blanche ( www.whitehouse.gov ). Plus précisément, le(s) programmateur(s) du ver visai(en)t l'adresse IP de la Maison Blanche, 198. 137. 240. 91. Le ver fut découvert par le responsable en chef du hacking d'une compagnie privée, eEye Digital Security. Ce ver a infecté l'index de la version anglaise du serveur internet d'information de Microsoft. Dans les versions non anglaises, le ver est dormant. Il s'est transmis plus rapidement que n'importe quel autre. Pour plus de détails sur son fonctionnement voir sur Eeye.com. © 2001 iEntry, Inc. Tous droits réservés. Créé le 03-08-01. title: New Viruses and Protection Against Them
text: About New Viruses and Protection Against Them If you have received a worm in your email box called "W32/Sircam" and if you suspect your computer to be infected by this worm (or any other virus) you can have your computer scanned and cleaned up online for free at www. antivirus. com . Follow the simple directions on screen. The scanning for virus takes 30-45 minutes (online), depending on how much data is stored on your hard drive. The cleaning up is done manually (offline) by following the simple directions given on screen, and takes only a few minutes. The virus scan can be done anonymously, i. e. that you don't have to leave your e-mail address. Your computer will be scanned for all known viruses, also the newest that are not included in many antivirus-programs. If the scanning operation finds a virus on your computer the infected files will be flagged, so that they are easy for you to identify and clean up. Once cleaned up, protect yourself against attacks on your computer. Make sure *NEVER* to open any e-mail with executable attachments, unless you are 100% sure of what the attachment contains, and/or you are 100% sure of the sender's computer security level. If you are unsure, check the attachment as such for virus, or simply remove it completely from your computer *WITHOUT* opening the infected e-mail. Please read below for a description of this particular worm. This is an email attachment worm from Mexico with different subject lines but the words in the email looks like this in English: Hi! How are you? I send you this file in order to have your advice See you later. Thanks. The other version is in Spanish and it looks like this: � Hola como estas ? Te mando este archivo para que me des tu punto de vista. Nos vemos pronto, gracias. Basic Information W32/Sircam is a worm that propagates through e-mail by sending itself out to all the addresses found in the infected user's Outlook Address Book. Once installed on the system, the worm modifies the Windows Registry in order to ensure its execution every time an EXE file is executed. Finally, one of every ten times the worm will delete some data from the computer's hard disk. Means of Propagation After infecting the computer, W32/Sircam mails itself out to all the entries found in the infected user's Address Book. [Note: Norton's site says that it also scans files from your IE browsers cache for email addresses and mails it to them. For more info. check: Sarc. com] The message sent has the following characteristics: Attachment: A file with double extension, as the worm infects the system by copying itself at the beginning of targeted files, and adds another extension to the original one. Symptoms of Infection The first symptom of infection is the reception of an e-mail message with the characteristics described above. When the user executes an infected file, W32/Sircam creates two hidden copies of itself in the C:\Recycled directory. The first one is named after the attachment included in the e-mail message (without the extension added by the virus), whereas the second one is called SIRC32. EXE. Next, W32/Sircam will create a third copy of itself in the Windows system folder under the name SCAM32. EXE. Furthermore, the worm [can] generate a file called SYRCAM. SYS and writes text to it until all the available free space in the hard disk is completely used up. From: NetSecurity.Net For those running NT and 2000 servers, please note: There is another worm called Code Red that affects IIS Servers: A worm is like a virus in that that it can replicate itself. However, unlike a virus, it does not infect other files. This particular worm was created by the Chinese as an attack against the U. S. White House's website www. whitehouse. gov . Specifically, the coder(s) of the worm pointed to the White Houses IP address, 198. 137. 240. 91. The worm was brought to light by the chief hacking officer for a private company, eEye Digital Security. The worm infects the index server of the English version of Microsoft's Internet Information Server. In non-English versions, the worm is dormant. The worm has spread faster than any other. For more detailed information on how it works: Eeye. com. � 2001 iEntry, Inc. All Rights Reserved. title: Illegal Stamp Issues from Chad
text: Support lining up for UPU’s new stamp control system UNIVERSAL POSTAL UNION Berne, 5 March 2002 International Bureau Circular More than 70 postal administrations have already joined the Universal Postal Union’s new stamp control system that is aimed at combatting unauthorised stamp issues. The initiative has also received support from major international philatelic bodies within the World Association for the Development of Philately (WADP) which operates under the auspices of the UPU. Known as the WADP Numbering System (WNS), it is aimed at strenghtening the position of authenticated postage stamps while at the same time protecting the interests of stamp issuing countries, stamp collectors, philatelists and the stamp trade. The new numbering system applies to all stamps issued by participating countries on or after 1 January 2002. All new stamps, stamp sets, souvenir sheets and sheetlets submitted to the UPU by these countries since the beginning of 2002, are allocated a unique number to facilitate the creation of a universal stamp inventory. The unique number includes the ISO Alpha 2-letter country code. The scanned stamps, together with a brief description and the WNS numbers, will be made available to all interested parties, including Posts, catalogue producers, the philatelic trade and philatelists. The new system will further act as a central register of authentic issues against which stamp issues can be verified. It is, however, not intended to replace stamp numbering systems of stamp catalogues, but rather to complement them by allowing easier recognition of the legitimate issues. The UPU envisages that more postal administrations will join the numbering system as it develops in the months to come. Stamps without a WNS number could in future be banned from international exhibitions. The International Federation of Philately (FIP) is already considering such measures and other philatelic organizations are expected to follow. Recent years have seen an increase in postage stamps produced without the knowledge or authorization of legitimate countries, or in the name of territories which do not qualify for the issuing of postage stamps, or which simply do not exist. The sale of unauthorized stamps not only defrauds collectors, but can lead to severe losses in revenue for postal administrations. More information about the illegal issues can be obtained directly from the UPU, Mrs. Maria Libera . Published: 03/05/2001. Revised: 03/05/02 . title: Le Open DirectoryPproject
text: ODP - Le " Open Directory Project " ( Projet de répertoire ouvert ) L'Organisation des Webmasters Philatéliques (PWO) continue à fournir des information aux Webmasters intéressés par tout ce qui peut être utile à leur activité. Nous publions ici des suggestions, mais mentionnons également ce qu'il vaut mieux éviter quand on veut s'inscrire dans l'ODP (Open Directory Project. En tant que collaborateur actif de l'ODP, responsable de la sous catégorie philatélique "thématique", le fondateur du présent site ne peut que recommander à tout Webmaster philatélique d'utiliser les possibilités offertes par l'ODP. L'ODP, parfois également dénommé DMOZ, construit un vaste répertoire de sites Web en s'appuyant sur une équipe de milliers de collaborateurs volontaires. Au cours des dernières années, le Open Directory Project s'est considérablement étendu, car il fournit des répertoires à des moteurs de recherche tels que Lycos, HotBot, Netscape, AOL Search, Google, et cette liste ne cesse de s'accroître. Plus simplement, s'inscrire dans l'ODP signifie que même si vos pages ne sont pas indexées par Lycos, HotBot, ou AOL Search, vous serez néanmoins présents dans ces moteurs, grâce à l'ODP. Les 10 meilleurs suggestions pour faire figurer votre site dans l'ODP 1. Consacrez un peu de temps à naviguer dans l'ODP afin de choisir la meilleure sous catégorie pour votre site. Si votre site est dans une langue autre que l'anglais, vous devez choisir la catégorie "monde" (World). 2. Donnez-lui un titre professionnel, presque commercial, et faites apparaître dans sa description les principaux mots clefs. Soyez honnêtes et sincères. 3. Complétez entièrement et avec précision le formulaire d'inscription. Assurez-vous que votre URL est correctement mentionnée ! 4. Inscrivez votre URL principale dans la meilleure sous catégorie. Si vous avez une page intérieure "indépendante" et contenant des informations intéressantes, vous pouvez essayer de la faire inscrire dans une autre sous catégorie. 5. Ne mentionnez sur votre site "dernière mise à jour le ..." que si cette mise à jour est récente. 6. Essayez que votre site fonctionne du mieux possible ! Est-ce que toutes les illustrations se chargent bien ? N'y a-t-il aucun lien invalide ? 7. Assurez-vous que votre site est d'une lecture facile, avec un choix judicieux de coloris, et des tailles de caractères correctement choisies. 8. Si vous avez des questions particulières, contactez le responsable de la catégorie, en cliquant sur son nom qui figure en fin de la page de la catégorie concernée. 9. Lorsque vous écrivez à un responsable, soyez polis ! Pensez-vous vraiment que quelqu'un va quitter ce qu'il fait pour s'occuper d'une demande spéciale, si vous lui avez envoyé des saletés ? 10. Si vous écrivez à un responsable, exprimez une demande simple et courte. Indiquez ensuite l'URL et le titre de votre site, une courte description, et la catégorie choisie (pour celle indiquez en le chemin complet). Ne demandez pas au responsable de deviner, ou de choisir lui-même la catégorie. Ne décrivez jamais votre site comme "cool", exceptionnel, fantastique, etc. ; et ne demandez pas non plus qu'il soit listé comme tel ! Les 10 pires choses à éviter 1. Ne vous inscrivez pas dans une en-tête de catégorie, telle "Sports : Basket-ball", mais dans une sous catégorie précise, telle "Sports : Basket-ball : Règles : Signification des signaux manuels". 2. Ne vous contentez pas de dresser la liste des mots clefs dans le titre ou la description. Et n'y abusez pas de textes publicitaires. 3. La description ne doit pas être trop longue. Quelques phrases seront parfaites ; n'en faites pas plus. 4. N'écrivez pas votre titre ou la description TOUT en majuscules. 5. N'inscrivez votre site que lorsqu'il est prêt à être visité et qu'il a été mis à jour récemment. Les sites avec un énorme "En travaux" en première page, et d'autres ailleurs, ne sont pas prêts pour accueillir des visiteurs. 6. N'inscrivez pas des pages de votre site dans toutes les catégories qui vous semblent avoir un rapport plus ou moins lointain avec lui. N'oubliez pas que les responsables échangent des notes et s'informent mutuellement sur certains sites. La chose à éviter est que nombre d'éditeurs fassent des commentaires du genre "trop d'inscriptions" ou, pire, "pollue l'index". 7. N'inscrivez pas votre site chaque jour (ou tous les deux jours) jusqu'à ce qu'il soit accepté. S'il n'est pas indexé dans un délai de trois semaines, inscrivez-le de nouveau en prenant le temps de le faire correctement. 8. Si votre site n'est constituée que d'une page, retravaillez-le. Construisez quelque chose d'original ! Créez des pages intérieures avant de vous inscrire. 9. L'ODP est devenue très stricte avant d'ajouter des URL, et de telles inscriptions sont généralement rejetées immédiatement. 10. Méfiez vous de l'utilisation de technologies du genre de Flash, Shockwave, etc., cela oblige le responsable à télécharger des compléments pour pouvoir voir votre site. N'oubliez jamais que les responsables de l'ODP sont des volontaires bénévoles, et qu'ils ont nombre d'autres occupations. Rendez votre inscription facile à accepter et elle le sera. Si le responsable rencontre des difficultés, vous serez moins chanceux. Toutes ces suggestions sont dues à M. Robin Nobles, Directeur de la formation à l' Academy of Web Specialists . Merci M. Nobles ! Créé le 03-08-01. Modifié le 16-09-01 . Copyright © 2001 PWO et Victor Manta , Suisse. Tous droits réservés dans le monde entier. Language

title: Tips for Webmasters
text: ODP - The Open Directory Project The Philatelic Webmasters Organization (PWO) continues in bringing information to interested Webmasters that is useful for their activity. In this article we are publishing some suggestions, but also things to avoid when getting listed in the Open Project Directory (ODP). As an active Editor at the ODP, responsible for the Topical Stamps subcategory, the founder of this site can only recommend to any Philatelic Web publisher to make use of possibilities offered by the ODP. The ODP, also known as DMOZ, produces a comprehensive directory of Web sites by relying on a team of thousands of volunteer editors. Over the past few years, the Open Directory Project has boomed in importance, because it provides directory results to search engines like Lycos, HotBot, Netscape, AOL Search, Google Directory, and the list goes on and on. Simply put, submitting to the ODP means that even if you can't get your pages indexed by Lycos, HotBot, or AOL Search, you'll still have a presence in those engines, thanks to the ODP. Top Ten Suggestions for Getting Your Site listed in the ODP Spend some time cruising the ODP and choose the best subcategory for your site. If your site is in a language other than English, you'll need to submit to the World category. Create a businesslike and professional title and description using your important keywords. Be honest and sincere. Complete the submission form accurately and completely. Make sure that the URL is listed correctly. Submit your main URL in the best subcategory. If you have an interior page that stands on its own and has a lot of relevant information, you can try submitting it into a second subcategory. List a "last updated on <date>" note on your site, but only if it's been updated very recently. Make your site the best it can be! Do all graphics load? Are there any broken links? Make sure that your site is easy to read with good color choices and an adequate sized font. If you have special requests, contact the editor of that category by clicking on the editor's name at the bottom of the category page. When writing to an editor, be respectful! Do you honestly think an editor will go out of his/her way to fulfill a special request if you send a nasty note? When writing to an editor, state your request simply and quickly. Then, list your URL, the title of the site, a description, and the category (the complete path where you want the site listed). Don't make editors guess or have to figure out the category themselves. And, neither describe your site as cool, exceptional, fantastic, etc. nor "demand" that your site should be listed as such! Top Ten Things to Avoid Don't submit in upper-level categories, such as Sports: Basketball. Instead, submit to the proper and exact subcategory, such as Sports: Basketball: Officiating and Rules: Basketball Hand Signals. Don't just list keyword after keyword in the title or description. And, don't use an abundance of marketing hype in your title or description. Don't create a description that is too long. A few sentences are fine, but don't make it any longer than that. Don't put your title and description in ALL CAPS. 5. Don't submit your site until it's ready for traffic and has recently been updated. Sites with a huge "under construction" sign on the first page and little else aren't ready for traffic. Don't submit pages of your site to every single category that you can possibly think of that halfway pertains to your site. Keep in mind that the editors write notes to other editors about certain sites. The last thing you want is for a bunch of editors to make comments such as, "too many submissions," or even worse, "spamming the index." Don't submit your site every single day (or every other day) until it's accepted. If your site isn't indexed in three weeks, then submit it again, taking time to submit it properly. Don't submit your site every single day (or every other day) until it's accepted. If your site isn't indexed in three weeks, then submit it again, taking time to submit it properly. If your site is only one page, work on it some more. Build original content! Create some interior pages before you submit. The ODP has really gotten strict about affiliate URLs, and those submissions are generally rejected immediately. Be careful about using technologies such as Flash, Shockwave, etc., that requires the editor to download an add-on in order to view the site. Keep in mind that ODP editors are "volunteers" who aren't paid, and they're very busy people. Make your submission easy to accept and you'll get in. Make it difficult for the editor and you're out of luck. All this suggestions come from Mr. Robin Nobles, the Director of Training for the Academy of Web Specialists . Thanks, Mr. Nobles!
